traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Garryaceae: leaves opposite; leaves simple; margins entire; veins pinnate; leaves evergreen; stipules absent; plants dioecious; ovary inferior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers in catkins; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals or absent; fruit berry; parts of each whorl 4; stamens 4; carpels 2 (-3). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 400, 401, family Garryaceae: phyllotaxis pattern decussate; read as "decussate".

traits.inflorescence_posture.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 400, 401, family Garryaceae: inflorescence posture pendent; read as "pendent".
